description:
Replace an endpoint's body assertions.

    Each assertion is {"path": "$.ok", "op": "equals", "value": true}.
    Operators: equals, not_equals, exists, not_exists, gt, gte, lt, lte,
    contains, not_contains, empty, not_empty. A failing assertion marks the
    endpoint DOWN, so it counts against uptime. Pass [] to clear.
name: set_endpoint_assertions
